data.name: Aeeshan
data.gender_notes: Aeeshan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aeeshan is derived from the word 'eeshana' which means 'to help' or 'to assist'. This name is mentioned in the Hadith of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as the name of a companion who helped him during the Battle of Uhud. Thus, Aeeshan is a name of great significance in Islamic history, symbolizing the virtue of helping and supporting others.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies support and assistance in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Aeeshan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aeeshan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
